proposals.action_title: Launch the First KDP Coloring Book via Runware PAYG
proposals.why_this_works_now: KDP organic traffic is highly active for specific coloring niches. By spending ~2€ of the 20€ budget on Runware PAYG, Hugo can generate 40 ultra-clean FLUX-schnell coloring pages, compile them to PDF on GitHub Actions, and bypass the image quality blocker immediately.
proposals.first_action_today: Trigger the 'produce_coloring_book' pipeline on GitHub Actions using a 2€ Runware PAYG API key to generate 40 high-definition vector-style black & white coloring pages.

proposals.why_this_works_now: Sticker packs (multiple designs on one sheet) offer high perceived value. Creating niche designs for Linux/Termux enthusiasts and indie gamedevs allows Hugo to capture passionate audiences with zero ad spend.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 15 transparent PNG sticker assets using Together AI (FLUX-schnell) on GHA, package them into 3 thematic sticker sheets, and upload them via Termux/browser.

proposals.action_title: Upload Paid Parametric STLs to Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D is highly search-optimized. Functional 3D prints (like custom battery organizers, board game token trays, or cable management tools) sell consistently for 1.50€ to 3€ without needing complex marketing.
proposals.first_action_today: Run 'produce_stl_parametric' on GHA to compile 3 variations of functional organizers, write a clear SEO-optimized description, and upload them to Cults3D.

proposals.why_this_works_now: Bypasses the image generation bottleneck completely. Text-only interior layouts (grids, checklists, log sheets) are generated via python-reportlab on GHA. A clean, typographic cover attracts professional buyers looking for functional tools.
proposals.first_action_today: Run 'produce_lowcontent_kdp' to generate a 120-page 'Indie Game Developer Milestones & Bug Tracker' interior and upload it to KDP.

proposals.action_title: Launch a Premium itch.io 2D Pixel Art / UI Asset Pack
proposals.why_this_works_now: The indie gamedev community on itch.io constantly buys UI kits, seamless textures, and icon packs. Using 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' with Together AI to generate retro UI buttons or RPG icons yields immediate digital inventory.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate a bundle of 100 retro RPG item icons (potions, weapons, scrolls) on GHA, zip them with a markdown readme, and list the pack on itch.io for $2.99.
